get.description: Returns all business users for a business (admin only).

delete.description: Soft-deletes an employee: future reservations are reassigned or cancelled.

post.description: Uploads an employee avatar (multipart file). Visibility is private; allowed for the employee or an admin.
Adds a working hours override (e.g. holiday) for an employee.

delete.description: Removes a working hours override for an employee.

put.description: Replaces the set of services an employee offers.

post.description: Blocks a time range (e.g. vacation) for an employee.

delete.description: Deletes a previously created unavailability range.

get.description: Returns weekly working hours and date overrides for an employee.

put.description: Replaces the weekly working hours for an employee.

post.description: Uploads a business hero/logo/background image (multipart file). Visibility is public.

delete.description: Deletes an image. Admins delete the whole image; an employee may remove only their own avatar link.

post.description: Creates a new section on the salon's landing page, creating the page if needed.

put.description: Sets the position of every landing page section from the given ordered list of section IDs.
Replaces the content JSON of a section on the salon's landing page.
put.summary: Update a landing page section's content

delete.description: Deletes a section from the salon's landing page.

post.description: Adds a new service to a business.

put.description: Updates an existing service for a business.

delete.description: Removes a service from a business.

post.description: Uploads a service picture (multipart file). Visibility is public; services.picture_id is updated.
Creates a new appointment for the authenticated customer.

get.description: Returns a business with its services and employees by slug.
Returns all employees for a business.
Returns the salon's landing page sections ordered by position.
Returns all active services for a business.
Returns available time slots for a service and employee on a given date.
Returns the app's UI labels as a flat key/value object for the given locale.
get.summary: List UI labels for a locale

get.description: Public images are served directly; private images require auth and access (streamed through the API).
Returns the caller's approval status, whether they already own a salon, and the businesses they belong to.

post.description: Creates a business and the caller's owner (admin) row. Requires an approved account.

get.description: Returns all appointments for the authenticated customer.

delete.description: Cancels an appointment owned by the authenticated customer.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

content.description: Content is a locale-keyed JSON object.
